_note: Every number here is a PLACEHOLDER (2026-10-18) - tune freely.

effects._note: side = who the potion goes to when this effect is FIRST in the flask (hero = handed over and drunk, enemy = thrown). Every effect then lands on that target.

ingredients._note: main always counts (and stacks with copies); second only counts if a DIFFERENT ingredient in the flask has the same effect.

realtime._note: No ingredients arrive on their own: you start with a full hand and REDRAW (replace your hand) whenever its meter is full.

turns._note: Your turn: brew and hand over, then END TURN. The hero attacks (an enemy that chose BLOCK stops the first hit), then the enemy does what it showed (the hero always blocks: hits land at hero_block). Slow: the slowed enemy hits for slow_factor, for 1 turn per slow_turn_secs.
